description: Publish the caller's own approved social drafts on the caller's own connected X account or LinkedIn company page through the official APIs: list the channels, list the drafts, approve one draft, or post every approved draft now. A draft is never posted without approval.

action.description: targets = the channels this account can post to; drafts = the social_drafts rows; approve = set one draft to approved (needs draft_id); run = publish every approved draft now, one per channel.

draft_id.description: approve only: the row id (dd_id) from drafts.

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

name: social_publish
